description: This file defines the List module for HTMLPurifier, specifically handling list-related HTML elements such as <ol>, <ul>, <dl>, <li>, <dd>, and <dt>. It extends the base HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule class to register these elements and specify their content models.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_List
classes.description: A class representing the List module in HTMLPurifier, responsible for defining list-related HTML elements and their content models.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the list elements such as <ol>, <ul>, <dl>, <li>, <dd>, and <dt> with their respective content models in the purifier configuration.
